headline: Gold up about 1.4% today, silver up 3%, both still well below last month's levels
summary: 24K gold rose ₹175 to ₹12,655 per gram today, a move of 1.4% from yesterday, and 22K gold rose ₹160 to ₹11,600 per gram. Silver climbed ₹5,000 to ₹1,70,000 per kg, up 3.03% today, though it is still about 2.9% lower than seven days ago and down 22.7% from its high of ₹2,20,000 on 26 October. Over the 33 days covered by our data, 24K gold is down about 11% from ₹14,275, and today's bounce follows a low of ₹12,328 on 25 November; likely drivers include movements in international prices, the US dollar against the rupee, and seasonal jewellery demand, though the exact causes are not confirmed.
outlook: If you are buying for a specific need, today's rise is modest and prices are still well off October's peak, so comparing jeweller quotes including making charges and GST is more useful than timing the market.
